title: [Master Data Management] Cleanup when copying environment
summary: Master Data Management now cleans up sensitive data before environment copying, preventing confidential information from being transferred to copied environments.
key_points: Cleanup executes before environment copy operations
Prevents sensitive data leakage during environment duplication
Low risk change targeting pre-release functionality
Includes automated test coverage for the cleanup behavior
Affects Master Data Management Setup and transport codeunits
quote: We should do cleanup before environment gets copied
